enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse off. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Open kettle lid. Fill kettle with water. Close lid. Place kettle on base. Press button to boil. Open cupboard. Take out cup. Place cup on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk into cup. Close refrigerator. Kettle boils. Pour hot water into cup. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash dishes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out laptop. Place laptop in bag. Open drawer. Take out notebook. Place notebook in bag. Take out pen. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get up. Exit bus. Walk to community center. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: coordinating community programs, planning sessions and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleagues. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Call partner organization. Discuss program details. Take notes. Attend meeting. Present program plan. Listen to feedback. Write down action items. Make phone calls. Coordinate with volunteers. Update program schedule. Print documents. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Leave cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: running program logistics, answering emails and preparing community events
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Answer emails. Make phone calls to vendors. Order supplies for event. Check inventory. Pack materials for event. Load boxes into car. Drive to event venue. Unload boxes. Set up tables. Arrange chairs. Hang banners. Test audio equipment. Distribute flyers. Talk to venue staff. Confirm schedule. Return to office. Update event checklist.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Get up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Place induction cooker on counter. Plug in. Turn on. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir-fry. Add vegetables. Stir-fry. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up magazines. Place on shelf. Pick up cushions. Arrange on sofa. Pick up trash. Throw in bin. Move chairs. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Wipe coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on ottoman. Change channel. Watch movie. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get water. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer under the desk lamp to review the next day's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Log in. Open program schedule. Read schedule. Highlight important items. Make notes. Check emails. Reply to urgent email. Close program. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.
